title: Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets, focus on investor protection
summary: The Sebi chief said the proposed guidelines would focus on establishing appropriate guardrails for AI use, including disclosures, accountability of regulated entities, and a 'human-in-the-loop' approach.
llm_summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is drafting new rules to govern how artificial‑intelligence tools can be used in the country’s capital‑markets ecosystem. The guidelines will require firms to disclose AI‑driven processes, hold them accountable for any outcomes, and keep a “human‑in‑the‑loop” oversight mechanism to protect investors from errors or manipulation.
